videos.title: How do you actually use an MCP server?
videos.description:
How MCP Servers Actually Work in Claude Code!

The Playwright MCP server is a small Node.js program from Microsoft. Running claude mcp add playwright -- npx @playwright/mcp tells Claude Code to start that program on your laptop and talk to it over standard input and output. The server then launches its own Chrome window and drives it, so the server and the browser both run locally. On connect, Claude Code’s MCP client asks which tools the server offers (browser_navigate, browser_click, browser_type, browser_snapshot). That handshake is called tool discovery.
